labels.O: the stop at hour 73 bound only the original canvas: work went on, or began, on another canvas
labels.I: one member's attempt, a call or an invitation, with uptake, upkeep or outcome left open
labels.P: a proposal to keep the mark in the sub or beyond it (flair, banner, merchandise, a game), not shown done
labels.C: carrying on contested: members said to let it go, judged it not worthwhile, or quarrelled over what to build
labels.U: carrying on conditioned on upkeep, access or the site's working
labels.R: the room kept, with rules or goals set for its future
